attchmntText: Tvs Supply Chain Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: TVS Supply Chain Solutions Limited filed an investor presentation regarding its Q2 and H1 FY27 earnings. The company reported consolidated revenue of Rs. 3,687 Cr for Q2 FY27, a 38.5% year-on-year increase. Profit after tax stood at Rs. 37 Cr, up 123.9% year-on-year. EBITDA reached Rs. 268 Cr, reflecting a 50.2% year-on-year growth with a margin of 7.3%. India revenue grew 64.1% to Rs. 1,177 Cr, while Rest of World revenue increased 29.0% to Rs. 2,510 Cr. The business development pipeline is valued at Rs. 8,200 Cr. The earnings conference is scheduled for November 16, 2026.

attchmntText: Tvs Supply Chain Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Change in Auditors of the company.
voiceSummary: TVS Supply Chain Solutions Limited approved the appointment of Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu India LLP as Internal Auditor for FY 2026-27 on November 13, 2026. The Board also approved Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Statutory Auditor S.R. Batliboi & Associates LLP issued Limited Review Reports on these results. Revenue for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, was Rs. 3,687.15 crores, compared to Rs. 3,335.22 crores in the same period last year. Profit before exceptional items and share of profit was Rs. 49.97 crores for the quarter, versus Rs. 22.42 crores previously. For the half year, revenue stood at Rs. 7,022.37 crores against Rs. 5,254.94 crores. Profit before exceptional items was Rs. 81.68 crores, compared to Rs. 39.95 crores in the prior year period.

attchmntText: TVS Supply Chain Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 13, 2026, titled "Press Release   Q2 FY27 Unaudited Standalone & Consolidated Financial Results".
voiceSummary: TVS Supply Chain Solutions Limited announced its Q2 FY27 unaudited financial results for the quarter ended 30th September, 2026. Consolidated revenue from operations grew 38% year-on-year to Rs. 3,687.2 crore. EBITDA increased 50.2% to Rs. 268.1 crore, with EBITDA margin expanding to 7.3%. Profit before tax rose 108% to Rs. 50.6 crore, while profit after tax more than doubled to Rs. 36.5 crore. For the first half of FY27, consolidated revenue grew 33.6% to Rs. 7,022.4 crore. EBITDA for H1 FY27 stood at Rs. 500.3 crore. The company reported an order pipeline of Rs. 8,200 crore. Revenue from new business reached Rs. 523 crore. Integrated Supply Chain Solutions revenue grew 24.8% to Rs. 2,487.9 crore. Global Forwarding Solutions revenue increased 79.1% to Rs. 1,199.3 crore.

attchmntText: TVS Supply Chain Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of Earnings Conference Call to be held on 16th November, 2026
voiceSummary: TVS Supply Chain Solutions Limited has announced an earnings conference call for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The event is scheduled for Monday, 16th November 2026, from 9:00 AM to 10:00 AM IST. The call will cover the Unaudited Financial Results for Q2 and H1 FY27. Management will provide an overview of business performance and outlook, followed by a Q&A session. The mode of attendance is teleconference. Dial-in numbers include +91 22 6280 1143 and +91 22 7115 8044. International toll-free numbers are available for the USA, UK, Singapore, and Hong Kong. Participants may pre-register via the DiamondPass link. The schedule is subject to change. This intimation is filed pursuant to SEBI Listing Regulations.
